in_arabic.name: بيرم

in_urdu.name: بیرم
in_urdu.meaning: عید الفطر یا عید الاضحیٰ کے لئے استعمال ہونے والا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: بیرم نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جو عید یا تہوار کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں عید الفطر یا عید الاضحیٰ کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، جو مسلمانوں کے لئے اہم مذہبی تعطیلات ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: बैरम
in_hindi.meaning: ईद के अवसर पर रखा जाने वाला नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: बैरम नाम का अर्थ है ईद या त्योहार। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में ईद के अवसर पर बच्चों को दिया जाता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका उपयोग ईद के महत्वपूर्ण त्योहार को मनाने के लिए किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: بیرم
in_pashto.meaning: د عید الفطر یا عید الاضحیٰ لپاره کارول شوی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: بیرم نوم د عربی کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د عید یا جشن معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون په دودیزو کړو کې د عید الفطر یا عید الاضحیٰ د لمانځلو لپاره کارول کیږي.

Historically, the name has been used in different Muslim communities to commemorate significant religious events. Spiritually, Bayram symbolizes joy, unity, and devotion among Muslims.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Bayram" refers to a joyous and celebratory occasion, in the Islamic calendar, that marks the completion of the annual pilgrimage to Mecca, known as Hajj. During this time, Muslims around the world come together to honor the memory of Abraham, Ibrahim, and his family's devotion to God. The celebrations associated with Bayram, including family gatherings, communal feasts, and gift-giving, foster a sense of unity and solidarity among the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: Bayram is a reminder of the spiritual journey that every Muslim should embark upon in their lifetime, which is to make the pilgrimage to Mecca and strive to live a life that is pleasing to God. The spirit of Bayram emphasizes the importance of showing kindness, compassion, and gratitude to family, friends, and all of creation. This spiritual significance encourages Muslims to reflect on their relationship with God and to renew their commitment to following God's guidelines in their daily lives. By embodying the qualities of Bayram as a person who brings joy and delight to others, Muslims can contribute to their own spiritual growth and the wellbeing of their communities.
